providerSetup.blocker: No eligible customer Tettra team, user API key, or signed-in provider session was available.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer on an eligible plan generates a dedicated user key, enters the team ID and key, then Relay runs health, reads, Safe denial plus approval, Dangerous mutation, revocation, and disconnect checks.

evidence.supports: Tettra calls the API experimental, customer-key based, and limited to eligible paid plans.
Keys are generated per user and team, inherit that user's page permissions including private categories, and should use a restricted dedicated user when appropriate.
Official page API documentation publishes create, update, new-page suggestion, and page-update suggestion operations.
Official category API documentation publishes category creation and category-item reads; its subcategory article currently omits a usable URL, so Relay does not invent one.
Search is a fixed-team GET-with-JSON-body endpoint returning up to five accessible pages.
Tettra also offers a separate customer-generated MCP key on Scaling plans; it is not OAuth, acts as the user, and needs team/support enablement.
